title: Inexplicable
summary: INEX'PLICABLE, adjective [Latin inexplicabilis; in and explico, to unfold.] That cannot be explained or interpreted; not capable of being rendered plain and intelligible; as an inexplicable mystery.

inlines.v: INEX'PLICABLE, adjective [Latin inexplicabilis; in and explico, to unfold.] That cannot be explained or interpreted; not capable of being rendered plain and intelligible; as an inexplicable mystery.
